senses.gloss:
ज्यैष्ठः N. of a lunar month in
[]
which the full moon stands in the
constellation ज्येष्ठा (corresponding
to May-June).
--ष्ठी
1 The
fullmoon day in the month of ज्यैष्ठ.
--2
A small house-lizard.

ज्यैष्ठिनेय a. Born from the eldest
or principal wife.

1 Precedence, priority of
birth, primogeniture, seniority.
--2
Pre-eminence, sovereignty.
